title: NOPE office 20-colour material palette
status: Proposal; not applied to Unity materials
space: sRGB hex base colours, not a 20-colour indexed-rendering limit
rules: No green, teal, olive, sage or mint.
Strong blue limited to portal energy and tiny status accents.
Preserve restored floor and existing scene geometry.
Smooth warm wood; no busy grain.
Office pad is plain leather, never a repair grid.

colours.name: Porcelain
colours.note: Neutral white plastic; avoid yellow or blue casts.

colours.name: Paper
colours.note: Warm paper only; do not tint the PC this colour.

colours.name: Graphite
colours.note: Charcoal metal and dark plastic.

colours.name: Ink
colours.note: Small high-contrast anchors.

colours.name: Aluminium
colours.note: One coherent metal finish.

colours.name: Plaster
colours.note: Light, warm architectural neutral.

colours.name: Stone
colours.note: Preserve original floor; do not replace its texture or layout.

colours.name: Walnut
colours.note: Broad clean boards, almost no visible grain.

colours.name: Warm timber
colours.role: Desk edge, stamp and form sorter
colours.note: Wood variation, not painted brown electronics.

colours.name: Cork
colours.note: Quiet simplified cork, not noisy mottling.

colours.name: Oxblood
colours.note: Large warm accent; no blue grid.

colours.name: Coral
colours.note: Clear warm coral, not muddy brown.

colours.name: Aubergine
colours.note: Darker and more violet than the leather pad.

colours.name: Apricot
colours.role: Selected function keys and tiny labels
colours.note: Small functional accents.

colours.name: Mustard
colours.note: A concentrated warm accent.

colours.name: Pale gold
colours.role: Flat flag sprites and small brass fittings
colours.note: Flags remain 2D.

colours.name: Terracotta
colours.note: Keep adjacent facades independently coloured.

colours.name: Lavender
colours.role: Document tray and a few keycaps
colours.note: Light purple plastic; avoid blue/periwinkle.

colours.name: Signal blue
colours.role: Portal energy and tiny status indicators
colours.note: Only strong blue family; never the default prop colour.

colours.name: Pearl mist
colours.role: Distant crowd and sparse glass reflections
colours.note: Low-chroma neutral; glass stays see-through.
